blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ahead of the sponsorship of the 2027 national budget at the Senate, Sen. Loren Legarda urged the chamber to remove unnecessary allocations from the General Appropriations Bill (GAB). Senate Resolution No. 777, filed by Legarda on Nov. 12, called on the Senate to “avoid the adoption of projects that may bloat the GAB” and instead allocate funding to initiatives that promote macroeconomic growth. “With better planning and more disciplined spending, we can contain the deficit and reduce our borrowing requirements.
